question: The internal bisectors of ∠Q and ∠R of ΔPQR meet at S. If m∠P = 75º, then m∠QSR is:
solution:
Given:

∠P = 75º

The internal bisectors of ∠Q and ∠R meet at S.

Formula used:

Sum of angles in a triangle: ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180º

Angle formed by the intersection of two angle bisectors:

∠QSR = 90º + (∠P / 2)

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3adaf3b58045e20e273e3c34483ed92efbd9d3e970d4a94cb4831d2c9b8c56c3.png] 

Calculate ∠Q + ∠R:

∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180º

75º + ∠Q + ∠R = 180º

∠Q + ∠R = 105º

Calculate ∠QSR:

∠QSR = 90º + (75º / 2)

∠QSR = 90º + 37.5º

∠QSR = 127.5º

**∴ m∠QSR = 127.5º.**
